2610.07675.title: EIO-Agents: The Missing Semantic Layer for AI Agent Evaluation
2610.07675.paper_summary: AI agents are entering production in increasingly consequential environments without a shared semantic standard for what their evaluations actually mean. Scores, traces, judge outputs, and multi juror findings are increasingly used to justify readiness and release decisions, yet they often do not specify what evidence supports a claim, what that evidence can establish, or how the claim leads to a decision. We introduce EIO-Agents, an open specification for interoperable AI agent evaluation built on two layers. The Evaluation Intelligence Ontology (EIO) provides the semantic layer through typed evidence, versioned behavioral predicates, evidence contracts, claims, witness rules, proof status, recurrence, and computable derivations for metrics, findings, controls, and PASS, REVIEW, or BLOCK decisions. The Portable Evaluation Record (PER) provides the system of record: a canonical, content addressed representation of one evaluation that preserves the evidence to decision chain and can be re derived, explained, and verified. Scores summarize, juries interpret, and traces record, but none of them define what the evidence means or what it can prove. EIO provides that missing semantic contract, while PER preserves the resulting evaluation as a portable and verifiable system of record. As AI agents assume greater operational responsibility, evaluation must become more than a collection of scores and verdicts; it must become an accountable artifact whose meaning, evidence, limitations, and decisions can be independently checked.
2610.07675.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理正在越來越重要的環境中投入生產，但對於它們的評估實際上意味著什麼卻沒有共享的語義標準。分數、痕跡、評審輸出和多位陪審團的發現越來越多地用來證明準備和發布決策的合理性，然而它們通常並未具體說明什麼證據支持某個主張，這些證據能夠證明什麼，或者這個主張如何導致一個決策。我們介紹了 EIO-Agents，一個基於兩個層次的可互操作 AI 代理評估的開放規範。評估智能本體（EIO）通過類型化證據、版本化行為謂詞、證據合約、主張、見證規則、證明狀態、重現性以及可計算的指標、發現、控制和 PASS、REVIEW 或 BLOCK 決策的推導提供語義層。可攜式評估記錄（PER）提供記錄系統：一個經典的、內容地址的單一評估表示，保留了證據到決策的鏈條，並且可以重新推導、解釋和驗證。分數進行總結，陪審團進行解釋，痕跡進行記錄，但它們都沒有定義證據的含義或它能證明什麼。EIO 提供了缺失的語義合約，而 PER 則保留了作為可攜式和可驗證的記錄系統的最終評估。隨著 AI 代理承擔更大的操作責任，評估必須超越分數和裁決的集合；它必須成為一個可負責的工件，其意義、證據、限制和決策可以被獨立檢查。
